content: Event-driven backtest engines (QuantStart, Backtrader, Zipline, NautilusTrader) use a central FIFO event queue and four decoupled components: DataHandler (emits MARKET events), Strategy (consumes MARKET, emits SIGNAL), Portfolio/RiskManager (consumes SIGNAL, emits ORDER, tracks positions/cash), and ExecutionHandler/Broker (consumes ORDER, emits FILL). Sequential event processing structurally prevents look-ahead; the same Strategy/Portfolio code paths run in backtest and live modes, with only the ExecutionHandler swapped for a real broker adapter.
